outcome: Cesarean section rate due to fetal distress
cohort: 308 antenatal women admitted to the labor ward of MIMS between February 2014 and December 2015, with gestational ages between 34 and 41 weeks
finding: Oligoamnios (AFI ≤5) was significantly associated with adverse perinatal outcomes, including non-reactive CTG, cesarean section due to fetal distress, low birth weight, APGAR score <7, and NICU admission.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rate due to fetal distress was significantly higher in the oligoamnios group.
